body.statement: For every \(\vartheta_n=(L_n,D_n)\in\Theta_n\), conditional on the fixed design, \(X_n^{(1)}\) and \(X_n^{(2)}\) are independent and each has distribution \(\mathcal N(\operatorname{vec}_{\Omega_n}(L_n),2\sigma^2I_{|\Omega_n|})\).
body.justification: The independent copy makes the conditional covariance calibration exact once the pilot is fixed.
body.gap: The four-block literature uses leave-one-out expansions; the randomized Gaussian split gives an exact conditional experiment for a joint nuclear certificate.
body.consumer: The certificate uses the inference copy for a conditionally Gaussian one-step correction and the pilot copy for synchronization.
